title: The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it
summary: The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it VentureBeat
body: The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it VentureBeat
summaryZh: 针对AI Agent误操作导致DNS配置被篡改的问题，提出了通过“人机协同”机制进行修复的方案。即Agent仅具备提案权，关键操作必须经过人工审批，这是AI Agent在企业级应用中安全落地的典型案例。原始信息显示：The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it VentureBeat。该消息由VentureBeat发布，主题为“The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it”。其重要性主要体现在：探讨了AI Agent在实际应用中的安全治理问题，具有行业参考意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
